definitions.explanation: An organized session where participants learn a specific skill or body of knowledge, typically over a short period.

examples.japanese: {講習会|こうしゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: To participate in a training course.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧{講習会|こうしゅうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A disaster preparedness workshop will be held next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}→安全管理：23551_anzenkanri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{講習会|こうしゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧きた。
examples.english: Since the company covered the cost, I attended a safety management training course.

notes:
A compound of {講習|こうしゅう} (training, instruction) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (gathering, meeting). Refers to organized training events that are typically shorter than full courses — often one day or a few sessions. Common in workplace training, community education, and certification programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講習会|こうしゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a workshop
- {講習会|こうしゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to attend a training course
- {講習会|こうしゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}む→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧: to apply for a workshop
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧{講習会|こうしゅうかい}: safety training workshop
- ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け→初心者向け：17934_shoshinshamuke⟧{講習会|こうしゅうかい}: beginners' workshop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦セミナー→セミナー：11000_seminaa⟧: seminar — often more academic or business-oriented; sometimes implies a lecture format
- ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: training; professional development — broader term; can refer to longer training programs
- ⟦ワークショップ→ワークショップ：06399_waakushoppu⟧: workshop — loanword increasingly used, especially for creative or hands-on sessions
- ⟦{勉強会|べんきょうかい}→勉強会：23197_benkyoukai⟧: study group — more informal; often self-organized among peers
